findings: buildResearchSnapshot() creates FULL_FORMAL_SCAN by default, but the current durable trade_research_snapshots path receives it through selected plan researchSnapshot persistence.
Non-selected research candidates use buildResearchSnapshot too, then explicitly overwrite sourceCompleteness to SHADOW_PROSPECTIVE before writing trade_research_shadow_candidates.
The Shadow archive is bounded: QUALIFIED_NOT_SELECTED / NEAR_MISS / REJECTED_AFTER_BASE / BROAD_CONTROL are capped per pool, so it is not a complete Formal-scan denominator.
Therefore FULL_FORMAL_SCAN in current persisted trade_research_snapshots describes row-level feature completeness, not complete scan-population coverage.
Institutional score saturation/divergence frequencies from persisted FULL_FORMAL_SCAN are selected-conditioned. Full-scan prevalence remains unidentified from current persistence.
